# Kevin Castro

> Senior software engineer who builds secure, AI-powered, and data-intensive
> systems in high-stakes, regulated domains — healthcare, energy, and
> conversational AI. Deepest experience is PHI-compliant infrastructure,
> HIPAA-grade data exchange, and high-volume transaction processing, with the
> same discipline carried into agentic document-reasoning pipelines, LLM/RAG
> infrastructure, and the eval frameworks that keep them honest in production.

## Work

- [Work index](https://kevincastro.dev/work): all case studies.
- [Rowland.ai](https://kevincastro.dev/work/rowland-ai): agentic document reasoning for lease extraction, benchmarked across 10,000+ scenarios.
- [PVcase](https://kevincastro.dev/work/pvcase): scaled ML product from $500K to $2MM ARR.
- [Redox](https://kevincastro.dev/work/redox): PHI exchange at scale, millions of records/day at 99.999% uptime.
- [DexCare](https://kevincastro.dev/work/dexcare): hybrid object storage inside a relational database.
- [Jubel Health](https://kevincastro.dev/work/jubel-health): conversational AI for personalized fertility care.
- [Castro Home Builders](https://kevincastro.dev/work/castro-home-builders): Astro rebuild and rebrand for a family business.
